title: Resource Analysis for Quantum Simulation of Spatially Varying Transport-Reaction Equations
summary: Spatially varying coefficients are the primary source of circuit complexity in quantum simulation of linear advection-diffusion-reaction equations. This work presents a resource analysis of single-step quantum propagators constructed using sparse FABLE block encodings, Quantum Singular Value Transformation, and linear-combination-of-unitaries.
